title: Umngane Owaphenduka
intro: Usuzokwembula indaba yomphefumulo owaphila emthunzini wobuprofethi kodwa wakhetha indlela eya encithakalweni. Lo muntu wabelana ngekhaya nomunye wezithunywa zika-Allah ezikhethiwe kodwa wehluleka ukuhlolwa kokholo. Ubani lo mngane olahlekile?
clues: Ngangiphila phakathi kwabantu abenqaba ukubizelwa ekulungeni, futhi angizange ngibaphikise.
Ngangishade nomprofethi ka-Allah, kodwa ngangingakholwa ngendlela efanayo.
Lapho izithunywa zifika ekhaya lami zingixwayisa, angizange ngizikholwe.
Umkami watshelwa ukuba ashiye umuzi namakholwa, futhi ngangingekho phakathi kwawo.
Isijeziso sehlela phezu kwabantu bakithi, nami ngabhujiswa kanye nabo.
Kukhulunywa ngami kwiQuran njengesibonelo sokungakholwa, kanye nomkaNuh, kuSurah At-Tahrim.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
